data.description: Rare Find in Harmony 3 | 5 BR Villa with Standalone Garden Suite | VOT
data.display_address: Harmony 3, Harmony, Tilal Al Ghaf, Dubai
data.long_description:
Laiali and Provident Real Estate are excited to present this exceptional 5-bedroom Type B (Large) villa, tucked into one of Tilal Al Ghaf's most sought-after clusters. It's the kind of home that wins over a growing family and a sharp-eyed investor in the same breath. With 5,710 sqft of upgraded living space on a generous 7,200 sqft plot, smart home tech, an EV charger, and seller-added upgrades throughout, this villa is vacant on transfer and priced below the most recent comparable sale in the community.

Why families will fall in love:

⦁ A bright, open-plan living and dining area with floor-to-ceiling glass opening onto a private garden
⦁ Polished large-format marble flooring throughout, with warm wood flooring in every bedroom
⦁ A show kitchen with a waterfall marble island, plus a fully equipped hidden scullery for everyday cooking
⦁ Five bedrooms, all with attached bathrooms
⦁ A spa-style primary suite with a dressing area, freestanding soaking tub, and separate rain shower
⦁ A standalone Garden Suite, perfect as a home office, gym, playroom, or guest space
⦁ Driver's and maid's quarters, under-stairs storage, and three covered parking spaces
⦁ Direct community access to the Crystal Lagoon, parks, walking trails, and tennis, paddle, and basketball courts

Why investors will want to move fast:

⦁ Priced below the most recent recorded comparable sale in Harmony 3
⦁ Tilal Al Ghaf is up nearly 5% year-on-year, an active growth market, not a plateau
⦁ A rare combination of size, upgrades, and a true standalone Garden Suite at this price point
⦁ Full community amenities that support strong rental and resale demand

Seller upgrades included:

⦁ Wood flooring in all bedrooms
⦁ Extended joinery throughout
⦁ Washing machines and additional cabinetry
⦁ Fully fitted kitchen appliances
⦁ Upgraded garage door
⦁ Electric vehicle charger
⦁ Smart home system

A complete, beautifully upgraded family home in one of Dubai's most in-demand master communities, priced to move.
